## Processing

```{r}

objs <- lapply(sample_files, readRDS)

for (i in seq_along(objs)) {
  sample_id <- objs[[i]]@project.name
  
  objs[[i]]$sample <- sample_id
  objs[[i]]$protocol <- "10X"
}

combined <- merge(
  x = objs[[1]],
  y = objs[-1]
)

rm(objs)

preHarmonyProcessing <- function(sobj) {
  
  print("Normalizing Combined Data...")
  sobj <- NormalizeData(
      sobj,
      normalization.method = "LogNormalize",
      scale.factor = 10000
  )
  
  print("Finding Variable Features...")
  sobj <- FindVariableFeatures(
      sobj,
      selection.method = "vst",
      nfeatures = 3000
  )
  print("Scaling Combined Data...")
  sobj <- ScaleData(
      sobj,
      vars.to.regress = c(
          "nCount_RNA",
          "percent.mt"
      )
  )
  
  print("Running PCA...")
  sobj <- RunPCA(
      sobj,
      features = VariableFeatures(sobj),
      verbose = FALSE
  )
  
  sobj <- RunUMAP(
      sobj,
      reduction = "pca",
      dims = 1:15,
      seed.use = 20200204
  )
  
  preHarmony <- DimPlot(
      sobj,
      reduction = "umap",
      group.by = "sample",
  )
  
  ggsave(file.path(here("Ghasemi_analysis", "results", "combined"), "preHarmony_Plot.png"),
         plot = preHarmony,
         width = 12,
         height = 10,
         bg = "white")
  
  return(sobj)
  
}

combined <- preHarmonyProcessing(combined)

```

```{r}

harmonyProcessing <- function(sobj) {
  
  set.seed(20200204)
  
  sobj <- RunHarmony(
    sobj,
    group.by.vars = "sample",
    theta = 2
  )
  
  ndim <- 15
  
  sobj <- FindNeighbors(
      sobj,
      reduction = "harmony",
      dims = 1:ndim
  )
  
  sobj <- FindClusters(
      sobj,
      resolution = 0.225,
      random.seed = 20200204
  )
  
  sobj <- RunUMAP(
      sobj,
      reduction = "harmony",
      dims = 1:ndim,
      seed.use = 20200204,
      min.dist = 0.1
  )
  
  sobj <- JoinLayers(sobj)
  
  combinedDimPlot <- DimPlot(
    sobj,
    reduction = "umap",
    group.by = "RNA_snn_res.0.225"
  )
  
  ggsave(file.path(here("Ghasemi_analysis", "results", "combined"), "combined_Dim_Plot.png"),
         plot = combinedDimPlot,
         width = 12,
         height = 10,
         bg = "white")
  
  return(sobj)

}

combined <- harmonyProcessing(combined)
saveRDS(combined, file.path(here("Ghasemi_analysis", "results", "combined"), "combined.rds"))

```

```{r}

# Specific function to run entire integration workflow

runIntegration <- function(sobj) {
  
  sobj <- preHarmonyProcessing(sobj)
  sobj <- harmonyProcessing(sobj)
  return(sobj)
}

# removal of visually identified non-malignant clusters and re-running of processing

sce <- scDblFinder(sce, samples = "sample")   # add samples = "sample" if multi-sample
combined$dbl_class <- sce$scDblFinder.class
DimPlot(combined, group.by = "dbl_class")
table(combined$dbl_class)

combined <- subset(combined, subset = dbl_class == "singlet")


saveRDS(
  combined,
  file.path(
    here(),
    "Ghasemi_analysis",
    "results",
    "combined",
    "malignant_base_before_reintegration.rds"
  )
)

combined <- runIntegration(combined)
saveRDS(combined, file.path(here("Ghasemi_analysis", "results", "combined"), "combined.rds"))
```

```{r}

# CLUSTERING STABILITY #


############################################################
# 1. FUNCTION TO EXTRACT AND SAVE RESULTS
############################################################

saveClusterResults <- function(
    sobj,
    iteration_name,
    cluster_column = "RNA_snn_res.0.175",
    output_dir = "cluster_comparison_results"
) {
  
  # Create output directory if needed
  if (!dir.exists(output_dir)) {
    dir.create(output_dir, recursive = TRUE)
  }
  
  # --------------------------------------------------------
  # Cell-level information
  # --------------------------------------------------------
  
  cell_assignments <- data.frame(
    cell = colnames(sobj),
    sample = sobj$sample,
    cluster = sobj[[cluster_column]][, 1],
    stringsAsFactors = FALSE
  )
  
  
  # --------------------------------------------------------
  # Cluster sizes
  # --------------------------------------------------------
  
  cluster_sizes <- as.data.frame(
    table(cell_assignments$cluster)
  )
  
  colnames(cluster_sizes) <- c(
    "cluster",
    "n_cells"
  )
  
  
  # --------------------------------------------------------
  # Sample × cluster counts
  # --------------------------------------------------------
  
  sample_cluster_counts <- table(
    cell_assignments$sample,
    cell_assignments$cluster
  )
  
  
  # --------------------------------------------------------
  # Sample × cluster proportions
  #
  # Each row sums to 1, so this tells us how each sample's
  # cells are distributed across clusters.
  # --------------------------------------------------------
  
  sample_cluster_props <- prop.table(
    sample_cluster_counts,
    margin = 1
  )
  
  
  # --------------------------------------------------------
  # Save everything as one small RDS
  # --------------------------------------------------------
  
  results <- list(
    iteration = iteration_name,
    cell_assignments = cell_assignments,
    cluster_sizes = cluster_sizes,
    sample_cluster_counts = sample_cluster_counts,
    sample_cluster_props = sample_cluster_props
  )
  
  saveRDS(
    results,
    file = file.path(
      here(),
      "Ghasemi_analysis",
      "results",
      "cluster_stability",
      paste0(iteration_name, "_cluster_results.rds")
    )
  )
  
  # Return results invisibly in case we want to inspect them
  invisible(results)
}


dir.create(
  file.path(
    here(),
    "Ghasemi_analysis",
    "results",
    "cluster_stability"
  ),
  recursive = TRUE,
  showWarnings = FALSE
)

sample_order <- c(
  "AK1",
  "MB295",
  "MB299",
  "MB287",
  "AK3",
  "MB266",
  "MB263",
  "MB88",
  "AK2"
)


for (n in 9:2) {
  
  print("-------------------------")
  print(paste0("Running ", n, "-sample integration"))
  print("-------------------------")
  
  if (n != 9) {
    keep_samples <- sample_order[1:n]
    
    combined <- subset(
      combined, 
      subset = sample %in% keep_samples
    )
    
    combined <- runIntegration(combined)
  }
  
  
  saveClusterResults(combined, n)
  
}

result_files <- list.files(
  here("Ghasemi_analysis", "results", "cluster_stability"),
  pattern = "\\.rds$",
  full.names = TRUE
)

results <- lapply(result_files, readRDS)

names(results) <- sapply(results, function(x) x$iteration)

reference <- results[["9"]]

ref_assign <- reference$cell_assignments

comparison <- function(n) {
  
  test_assign <- results[[as.character(n)]]$cell_assignments
  
  comparison_9vX <- inner_join(
    ref_assign,
    test_assign,
    by = "cell",
    suffix = c("_reference", "_reduced")
  )
  
  comparison_9vX <- comparison_9vX %>%
    dplyr::select(
      cell,
      sample = sample_reference,
      cluster_reference,
      cluster_reduced
    )
  
  overlap_comparison <- comparison_9vX %>%
    dplyr::count(
      cluster_reference,
      cluster_reduced,
      name = "cell_count"
    )
  
  overlap_comparison <- overlap_comparison %>%
    group_by(cluster_reference) %>%
    mutate(
      reference_cluster_total = sum(cell_count),
      proportion = cell_count / reference_cluster_total
    ) %>%
    ungroup()
  
  overlap_comparison_plot <- ggplot(
    overlap_comparison,
    aes(
      x = factor(cluster_reduced),
      y = factor(cluster_reference),
      fill = proportion
    )
  ) +
    geom_tile() +
    geom_text(
      aes(label = sprintf("%.2f", proportion))
    ) +
    labs(
      x = paste0("Cluster in ", n , "-sample integration"),
      y = "Cluster in 9-sample reference",
      fill = "Proportion",
      title = paste0("Cluster stability: 9 samples vs ", n, " samples")
    ) +
    theme_minimal()
  
  overlapfilename <- paste0("overlap_9v", n, "_plot.png")
  
  ggsave(
    file.path(
      here(),
      "Ghasemi_analysis", 
      "results",
      "cluster_stability",
      overlapfilename),
    plot = overlap_comparison_plot,
    width = 12,
    height = 10,
    bg = "white")
}

for (i in 8:2) {
  comparison(i)
}


```
